response.courseDescription: 416 Mechanical Systems Design Integrative design in mechanical engineering; multidisciplinary design project considering both technical and non-technical contexts; organizational dynamics and communications.
response.coursePrerequisites: ME major; ME 304; ME 316; ME 348; ME 415; sr standing; OR MSE major; MSE 320; MSE 413 or concurrent; one of MSE 331, 332, or 333; jr standing; OR MSE major; MSE 202 with a C; MSE 318 with a C; MSE 413 or concurrent; jr standing.
